# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** 10-12 years old  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a dark, small face, black eyes, and a sullen expression.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008)_

## Personality

Anthony is a clever, independent, and cheeky boy who holds firm opinions and isn't easily influenced by others. He has a dark, sullen, and insolent demeanor, often acting defiantly or showing disdain toward authority. He holds a strong prejudice against female teachers, believing they are useless and expecting them to lack discipline.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008), [v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011), [v1 c27 P26](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0026)_

## Traits

- Cheeky  <sub>[v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008)</sub>
- Clever  <sub>[v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008)</sub>

## Abilities

- Fighting  <sub>[v1 c27 P26](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0026)</sub>

## History

Anthony attends the Brierley school under Nell Harcourt's instruction. From the beginning, he displays an insolent attitude toward Nell, believing female teachers are inferior to male teachers. During one afternoon, he empties his slate water down the neck of a classmate and receives a thrashing with a pointer from Nell as punishment. Following this discipline, he comes to respect Nell and begins treating her with courtesy, even offering to carry her books to school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008), [v1 c27 P26](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0026), [v1 c27 P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Had only been taught by male teachers prior to Nell Harcourt's arrival  <sub>[v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008)</sub>
